name: Blessed Arm
summary: In Stormwind, Glorin Steelbrow sends lightforge iron toward a weapon against Morbent Fel. You bring the rare metal from the wreck of the Flying Osprey in the Wetlands to master weaponsmith Grimand Elmore, who can forge it for the fight.

sections.title: A Rare Metal Returns
sections.body: Glorin Steelbrow packs the recovered lightforge iron for Stormwind. Rare and powerful against foul and unholy beings, the metal needs a smith who knows how to work it. The shipment came from the wreck of the Flying Osprey off the Wetlands coast. Glorin knows only one artisan in the southern kingdoms suited to the task: master weaponsmith Grimand Elmore.

sections.title: The Dwarven District's Forge
sections.body: In Stormwind's Dwarven District, Grimand Elmore keeps one of the city's finest anvils. Years have passed since he last hammered lightforge iron, he says, when you bring him the recovered shipment. The veteran artisan welcomes the chance to strike at the necromancer Morbent Fel. He agrees to put his hammer to work.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this delivery?
aliases: what is crate of lightforge ingots for
faq.answer: The crate holds lightforge iron salvaged from the Flying Osprey wreck in the Wetlands. Glorin Steelbrow sends it to Grimand Elmore, who can forge the consecrated metal into a weapon against Morbent Fel.

aliases: who is the smith in dwarven district
faq.answer: Grimand Elmore is a respected dwarven weaponsmith in Stormwind's Dwarven District. Few craftsmen have the training to forge specialized metals such as lightforge iron.

faq.q: Why is lightforge iron so important against Morbent Fel?
aliases: how does lightforge iron hurt morbent fel
faq.answer: Lightforge iron has power against foul and unholy beings. Grimand Elmore can forge the consecrated metal into a weapon against the necromancer Morbent Fel.

faq.q: Where does Glorin Steelbrow send you?
aliases: where do i go for blessed arm
faq.answer: Glorin Steelbrow sends you from Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands to Grimand Elmore's forge in Stormwind City's Dwarven District.

faq.q: Has Grimand Elmore worked with lightforge iron before?
faq.answer: Yes. Grimand says years have passed since he last worked with lightforge iron. He welcomes the chance to shape the storied metal again.

faq.q: What must happen before the weapon can be finished?
faq.answer: Grimand agrees to forge the recovered lightforge iron into Morbent's Bane. When he is finished, you take the weapon to Sven Yorgen in Duskwood.

angles.text: Lightforge iron is rare and difficult to work. Watching the experienced dwarven smith Grimand Elmore take it on shows the skill needed to forge holy arms.
As a paladin, you carry consecrated iron to forge a weapon against a Duskwood necromancer. That follows the Silver Hand's calling: meet dark sorcery with holy vigilance.
As an Alliance member, you carry aid between kingdoms, from a dwarven priest in Menethil Harbor to Stormwind's Dwarven District. The people of Duskwood are beleaguered.
